description:
A new server has been provisioned to handle frontend build workloads. You need to register it as a node in Jenkins to scale our build capacity.

Navigate to 'Manage Jenkins' > 'Nodes' (or 'Manage Nodes and Clouds') and create a new 'Permanent Agent' with the following specifications:

- Name: frontend-builder-01
- Remote root directory: /opt/jenkins-agent
- Number of executors: 4
- Labels: frontend linux high-mem
- Usage: Only build jobs with label expressions matching this node
- Launch method: Launch agent by connecting it to the controller

You are already logged in as admin. If prompted to log in, use Username: admin, Password: Admin123!
